intermediate.frozen_proposal_pool: Use every ranked candidate exactly as recorded; do not regenerate, filter, or use truth during scoring.

descriptor.name: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 normalized CLS
descriptor.score: Maximum cosine to the three frozen physical-door reference crops; compare raw frozen DINO and the fixed residual adapter.

evaluation.truth_timing: IoU is read only after both rankings are complete; it never selects a crop, score, candidate, reference, or adapter.

gate.requirements: The adapter must put the reachable highest-IoU proposal at Top-1 for both queries, improve over raw DINO on at least one query, regress on none, and retain minimum Top-1 IoU 0.8.

next_action: Run the already-separated fresh active-view and local Development heldout regression checks, then integrate the instance score as a genuinely distinct candidate generator.
fallback_action: Close parametric adapter reranking for this consumed DPC family and test a non-parametric foreground patch-memory candidate generator on a new target-disjoint family; do not tune on DPC1 or DPC2.
claim_boundary: The DPC family is target-family-disjoint from adapter training but its historical failure is already known, so this is consumed-holdout Development, not fresh confirmation. A result concerns proposal referent ranking only, not portal ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety.
